digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Tuesday, September 29 has nine meetings, two protected work blocks, nine carried-over actions, and five urgent items. The day’s priorities are setting the Amazon Connect recovery and Denver go/no-go posture at 10:30 AM, using the Attorney Review sessions to lock the October launch and SLC coverage plan, and assigning coverage for the 2:00 PM three-way conflict and 4:00 PM overlap. Amazon Connect remains the clearest delivery risk: Denver is still on hold while Salesforce investigates an account-wide production issue, although the test user is working and Denver training is complete.

items.label: Set Amazon Connect recovery and the revised Denver path
items.detail: Salesforce is handling the case at its highest support tier, with configuration, queue assignment, permissions, and agent-state synchronization still the leading suspects. A dedicated test user can log in and Denver training is complete; use the 10:30 AM standup to confirm the isolation owner, next test, and Denver go/no-go posture.

items.label: Choose the Attorney Review launch and SLC coverage plan
items.detail: The process is expected to go live October 15, ahead of the October 17 SLC opening with 25+ appointments. Use today’s 2:00 PM BD and 4:00 PM workflow sessions to confirm attorney coverage, rollout timing, and the owner for any remaining testable Service Cloud work.

items.label: Set the revised Mental Health RFE scope
items.detail: The work remains paused after the USCIS policy change reduced the eligible hard-deadline population. Confirm the sponsor decision among the roughly 95 VAWA cases, first-submission, or refile scope, then record the review owners and new planning trigger.

items.label: Confirm all five team self-reviews with HR
items.detail: Jean reported the team’s self-reviews complete, but a later HR message still listed Laura and Mar. Confirm all five submissions are recorded before closing the item.

items.label: Prioritize the Proactive Payday Notification intake
items.detail: The CFO-backed request is now in the CM-CoE queue. Confirm its priority, scope, and next owner so the intake moves without delay.

items.label: Connect with Amy on Incident Response communications
items.detail: Confirm the Bucket 6 notification trigger, communication owner, and remaining Incident Response Guide inputs with Amy.

items.label: Clarify the held Quality-routing deadline
items.detail: Send the interim status, revised decision point, and communication owner while the work waits for the new Phase 1 matter-plan structure.

items.label: Share the new legal-guidance protocol with the remaining PMs
items.detail: The Legal Request Tool is live. Brief the remaining PMs on when to include Leo, Raquel, or Cristian and how to separate mandatory legal guidance from recommendations.

items.label: Plan the newly launched downward reviews
items.detail: The review cycle is open through October 15. Confirm the assigned reviews and reserve writing time before the meeting-heavy week compresses the available window.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Set the owner and next diagnostic for the Salesforce production issue, then leave with a Denver go/no-go posture and a plan for the remaining office-readiness gaps.

items.label: 11:00 AM-1:30 PM - Slides, scoping, and 1:1 sequence
items.detail: Protect the 11:00 AM slides block. At 11:30 AM, the Close Case scoping call conflicts with Jhara’s 1:1; choose coverage before using the 12:30 PM block for follow-through.

items.label: 2:00 PM - Three-way decision conflict
items.detail: CM-CoE Court Projects Review, the Attorney Review BD working session, and the EPMO leadership catch-up begin together. Assign coverage and define the decisions each readout must return.

items.label: 3:30 PM - Nicolas 1:1
items.detail: Use the clean half hour to settle portfolio ownership and any items that need escalation into the 4:00 PM sessions.

items.label: 4:00 PM - SLC workflow and CSC portfolio overlap
items.detail: Choose coverage so the Attorney Review opening plan and the initial CSC portfolio review both end with named owners and next steps.

items.label: Assign coverage for today’s meeting conflicts
items.detail: Resolve the 11:30 AM, 2:00 PM, and 4:00 PM overlaps early. Name the attendee for each session and the decision or readout Jean needs back.

items.label: Lock the Close Case Taskset scope
items.detail: Use the 11:30 AM scoping call to define the process for voluntary termination of non-submitted cases, clarify affected phases, and leave with an owner and next deliverable.

items.label: Close the overdue Sales Cloud decisions
items.detail: The party-record migration decision and Lead Source/Source Type cleanup are both overdue, blocking UAT and training. Confirm the decision owners and dates with the sponsors.

items.label: Eugenia Barragán is out through October 1
items.detail: Route time-sensitive CoE and portfolio decisions around her absence.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Thiago 1:1 overlaps the Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Choose coverage so the deployment checkpoint and Thiago’s portfolio discussion both retain a clear decision path.

items.label: 2:00-3:00 PM - EPMO meeting overlaps Astrid’s 1:1
items.detail: Astrid’s 2:30 PM 1:1 sits inside the team meeting; move it or assign coverage before Wednesday.

items.label: 3:30 PM - Legal portfolio review conflicts with Laura’s 1:1
items.detail: Laura expects to be driving around this time and already suggested a new slot. Reschedule the 1:1 so the Legal portfolio review remains covered.
